argument: The contract never says what `slugify` should return for an empty string or for inputs that normalize to no words, even though the input/output types and output invariant still allow that case. A test author would have to guess whether the expected slug is `""` or some sentinel value, so this is underspecified.
arbitration: The algorithm step explicitly joins non-empty words with hyphens. When zero words exist, this deterministically produces an empty string satisfying all invariants including no leading/trailing hyphens. The contract behavior is fully specified and logically determinable; test authors need not guess.
